events.title: Special Tim Curry Tribute: IT (1990)
events.description:
Philadelphia Area Horror Meetup Group
Let's watch the original IT movie (tv miniseries) as a tribute to our king/queen of horror: TIM CURRY!!

This IT is my favorite and the best IT version!

**It**
1990 - 3hr 12mins
Horror/Drama
In 1960, seven preteen outcasts fight an evil demon that poses as a child-killing clown. Thirty years later, they reunite to stop the demon once and for all when it returns to their hometown.

events.title: JURASSIC PARK (1993)
events.description:
Philadelphia Area Horror Meetup Group
Come join us to stream the original and BEST Jurassic Park for Lyx' bday movie pick!!

**Jurassic Park**
1993 - 2hr 7mins
Adventure/Sci-fi

An industrialist invites some experts to visit his theme park of cloned dinosaurs. After a power failure, the creatures run loose, putting everyone's lives, including his grandchildren's, in danger.

events.title: THE WAILING (2016)
events.description:
Philadelphia Area Horror Meetup Group
As we get excited to see the new sci fi/horror film HOPE, let's watch another great film by director
Na Hong-jin!!

**The Wailing**
2016 - 2hr 36mins
Horror/Mystery
**Language:** Korean and Japanese with English subtitles

Soon after a stranger arrives in a little village, a mysterious sickness starts spreading. A policeman, drawn into the incident, is forced to solve the mystery in order to save his daughter...

events.title: REPO MEN (2010)
events.description:
Philadelphia Area Horror Meetup Group
Come watch a late night movie with us in honor of Summer's kidney bday/anniversary!!

**Repo Men**
2010 - 2 hours
Action/Sci-fi
Set in the near future when artificial organs can be bought on credit, it revolves around a man who struggles to make the payments on a heart he has purchased. He must therefore go on the run before said ticker is repossessed.
